name: Pullman Miri Waterfront Half Marathon Charity Run 2026
short_description: Pullman Miri Waterfront Half Marathon Charity Run 2026 is on Sunday 8 November 2026 at Pullman Miri Waterfront in Miri, over 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Pullman Miri Waterfront Half Marathon Charity Run 2026 starts at Pullman Miri Waterfront in Miri, Sarawak, on 8 November 2026. The 21 km half marathon flags off at 4:00 am and the 10 km at 6:00 am, and the event offers cash prizes. Race kit collection is on 6 and 7 November at the hotel.

faqs.question: What time does the Pullman Miri Waterfront Half Marathon Charity Run 2026 start?
faqs.answer: The 21 km half marathon flags off at 4:00 am and the 10 km run at 6:00 am on Sunday 8 November 2026. Both start at Pullman Miri Waterfront.

faqs.question: Where is race kit collection?
faqs.answer: Race kits are collected on 6 and 7 November 2026 from 10 am to 5 pm. The collection point is Level 6 of Pullman Miri Waterfront.
